hero.title: LET'S TALK
hero.subtitle: Have an idea? Let's build something extraordinary together.

faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I specialize in Applied AI & Data Analytics — building machine learning models, interactive Power BI dashboards, and agentic AI workflows using Python, SQL, and TensorFlow. I also craft modern, responsive web interfaces with React and Next.js.

faqData.q: Are you available for collaborations or freelance projects?
faqData.a: Absolutely. I'm open to freelance projects, internships, and collaborations in data analytics, AI/ML development, and frontend development. Whether it's building dashboards, training models, or crafting web experiences — I'd love to help.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack?
faqData.a: For data and AI: Python, SQL, Power BI, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and Pandas. For web development: React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. I also use Docker for containerization and Git for version control.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with real-world projects?
faqData.a: Yes. I've built projects like DigiSteel-YOLO (steel defect detection), a Healthcare Operations Dashboard, a Global E-Commerce Sales Tracker, and Azzar Auto Content Creation — each solving real problems with data-driven approaches.

faqData.q: How can we start working together?
faqData.a: The easiest way is to use the contact form above or email me directly at hazemelerefy@gmail.com. I typically respond within 24 hours and am happy to discuss how I can add value to your project or team.
